title: Caught in My Pocket
style: Caught-in-the-pocket jazz with bass-as-melody, led by foreground walking upright bass or lyrical fretless bass. Warm Rhodes comping, sparse piano voicings, brushed snare, and ride cymbal lock into a laid-back swing pocket. Close-mic breathy vocals, light tape saturation, soft room reverb, and subtle horn counterlines.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Got the blues in my pocket, gonna get some ice
I got a love in my socket, gonna get her twice
[whispered vocals] Caught in my pocket, caught in my pocket
[cymbal crash] [whispered vocals] Caught in my pocket
She said, "Love you like a rocket, but it ain't precise"
I said, "I can fix it, but it takes some vice"
[whispered vocals] Caught in my pocket, caught in my pocket
[cymbal crash] [whispered vocals] Caught in my pocket

[Chorus]

Sounds like, 'Zing, zing, zing,' it's

Said, "I don't know about that"
She said, "Just like a cat, I go
